annotation.title_clean: EU study calls for strategic AI adoption to transform public sector services
annotation.title_en: EU study calls for strategic AI adoption to transform public sector services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page summarising a commissioned study on AI adoption in public sector services (healthcare, mobility, e-government, education). It identifies barriers such as procurement, data management, regulatory uncertainty and bias, and recommends funding, transparency, cross-border data sharing and a clear regulatory framework. Prepared before the AI Act's entry into force.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI can improve public services in healthcare, mobility, e-government and education
Barriers: complex procurement, data management, regulatory unclarity, bias concerns
Recommends more funding and resources for public-sector AI
Recommends transparency, accountability and cross-border data sharing
Study predates the AI Act's entry into force on 1 August 2024
